title: 3 Cryptocurrencies Making Bold Moves in AI That Are Worth Buying and Holding for the Long Term
excerpt: AI agents might be the next big group of "users" to onboard to crypto.
content_html:
The age of artificial intelligence (AI) is here, and AI agents are now more empowered than ever to make and spend funds. Given that cryptocurrency is already a digitally native form of money that's highly accessible to machines, it makes sense that many of the industry's top players are positioning themselves to capture value from AI in a variety of different ways.

So without further ado, here are the three cryptocurrencies that are worth buying and holding for the long term thanks to their efforts to make big strides in AI and everything it involves.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

1. Ethereum is pioneering an ID card for on-chain AI

Since its launch in May 2025 through mid-July of this year, an internet payment standard called x402 has settled about 109.6 million machine-to-machine transactions, worth about $15 million in total. Ethereum (CRYPTO: ETH) is working on a separate piece of the same problem, tracking the identities and reputations of the AI agents doing that transacting.

Ethereum's newly launched identity standard for AI agents, ERC-8004, nicknamed Trustless Agents, addresses that issue with three new on-chain data registries that track identity, agent reputation, and independent validations of an agent's work. The idea is that as agents or humans use Ethereum's chain, they will now have a standardized set of identity criteria to confirm which agent is which across time, as well as a series of references for each agent's work history. Thus, it will pave the way for users and agents to be able to assess which agents are suitable for which kinds of tasks and why.

The ERC-8004 standard is already being picked up by more than 20 other networks, including plenty that have nothing to do with Ethereum. But the main downside is that for all the prestige-building and thought leadership the new standard does for Ethereum and its ecosystem, it can only lead to the coin itself experiencing a tailwind if it attracts more activity and more capital to its own network, not the networks of its peers.

2. Solana could be the place where agents trade tokenized stocks

Solana (CRYPTO: SOL) is pursuing a strategy to become a primary venue for trading tokenized stocks, which are cryptos that represent share ownership.

Trading in its on-chain tokenized stocks grew sixfold tin the first half of 2026, and it's now the home of more than 95% of all tokenized equity activity. Therefore, if there are AI agents designed for trading tokenized stocks, the odds are extremely high that they'll be configured to operate on Solana first. And that could well bring more activity to the chain, which might boost the price of the coin.

1. 以太坊正在开创链上人工智能的身份证

自 2025 年 5 月推出至今年 7 月中旬，名为 x402 的互联网支付标准已结算约 1.096 亿笔机器对机器交易，总价值约 1500 万美元。 以太坊（加密货币：ETH）正在研究同一问题的另一个部分，跟踪进行该交易的人工智能代理的身份和声誉。

以太坊新推出的人工智能代理身份标准 ERC-8004（绰号为“无信任代理”）通过三个新的链上数据注册表解决了这个问题，这些数据注册表可跟踪身份、代理声誉和代理工作的独立验证。 这个想法是，当代理人或人类使用以太坊链时，他们现在将拥有一套标准化的身份标准来确认哪个代理人是哪个代理人，以及每个代理人的工作历史的一系列参考。 因此，它将为用户和代理铺平道路，使其能够评估哪些代理适合哪种类型的任务以及原因。

ERC-8004 标准已经被 20 多个其他网络采用，其中包括许多与以太坊无关的网络。 但主要的缺点是，尽管新标准为以太坊及其生态系统带来了威望建设和思想领导力，但如果它吸引更多的活动和更多的资本到自己的网络，而不是同行的网络，它只会导致硬币本身经历顺风。

2. Solana 可能成为代理商交易代币化股票的地方

Solana（加密货币：SOL）正在寻求成为交易代币化股票（代表股权的加密货币）的主要场所的战略。

2026 年上半年，其链上代币化股票交易量增长了六倍，目前它已成为所有代币化股票活动 95% 以上的所在地。 因此，如果有专为交易代币化股票而设计的人工智能代理，它们首先被配置为在 Solana 上运行的可能性非常高。 这很可能会给该链带来更多的活动，从而可能会推高代币的价格。
